detail.query:
UNLOAD (

    SELECT
        numero_de_renta AS "Numero de Renta",
        replace(replace(format('%,.2f', valor_prima), ',', ''), '.', ',') AS "Prima Unica",
        tipo_de_renta AS "Tipo de Renta",
        fecha_expedicion AS "Fecha de Expedicion",
        periodo_point AS "Periodo Point",
        tipo_proceso AS "Tipo Proceso",
        tipo_proceso_act AS "Sub Tipo Proceso",
        ramo_point AS "Ramo",
        cod_tipo_endoso,
        periodo_corte AS "Periodo Corte"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CAST(nid_poliza AS VARCHAR) AS numero_de_renta,
            SUM(vlr_prima) AS valor_prima,
            'ARL' AS tipo_de_renta,
            fec_expedicion AS fecha_expedicion,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(per_proceso_point AS VARCHAR), ''), CAST(per_expedicion AS VARCHAR)) AS periodo_point,
            'PRIMAS_ARL' AS tipo_proceso,
            CASE
                WHEN cod_tipo_endoso = 2 AND SUM(vlr_prima) >= 0 THEN 'renta nueva'
                WHEN cod_tipo_endoso = 2 AND SUM(vlr_prima) < 0 THEN 'reintegro'
                ELSE 'reliquidación'
            END AS tipo_proceso_act,
            'ARL' AS ramo_point,
            cod_tipo_endoso AS cod_tipo_endoso,
            CAST(per_expedicion AS VARCHAR) AS periodo_corte
        FROM scd_primas_arl
        WHERE CAST(per_expedicion AS VARCHAR) = '$period'
        GROUP BY
            nid_poliza,
            fec_expedicion,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(per_proceso_point AS VARCHAR), ''), CAST(per_expedicion AS VARCHAR)),
            cod_tipo_endoso,
            per_expedicion
    )
    ORDER BY numero_de_renta ASC

)
TO 's3://$assets_bucket/athena/notifications/unload/$execution_id/'
WITH (
    format = 'TEXTFILE',
    field_delimiter = '|',
    compression = 'NONE'
);
